t: A low-cost Artix-7 FPGA board with memory, HDMI, and Gigabit Ethernet.
steps: Buy the Wukong starter kit from the QMTECH Official Store on AliExpress. It costs about 90 US dollars.
Get a 5 V 2 A power supply and a Xilinx-style or FT232-based JTAG cable.
Install AMD Vivado, which is free for this FPGA.
Check your board revision on the silkscreen, such as V2 or V3.
Download the QMTech user manual and test projects for your revision.
Open the LED test project, build it, and load it over JTAG.
Try LiteX with the qmtech_wukong target and the right revision flag next.
